ByRo Bot · AI says:

Welcome to By Rotation – happy to have you here! Here’s a simple path to get started:

Download & sign up: Get the By Rotation app, tap the profile icon, hit Get Started, and create your account. Complete your profile with a photo, location, and short bio, then finish ID verification so you can rent and lend.
Check availability: Rentals are available in the UK and US only, and you must be 18+.
Set up as a renter:
Once verified, you can request your first rental.
If you’re new, you’ll automatically get 15% off your first rental (orders over £20, used within 30 days, rentals only).
Set up as a lender:
Tap the “+” in the app to start your first listing.
Choose category and brand, describe the fit and any flaws, and add styling tips.
Upload high‑quality photos: real person wearing the item, multiple angles, and label/close‑ups for trust.
Set price, availability, and any discounts, then submit; we review within about 48 hours and then your item goes live.
Focus on higher‑end, luxury, vintage, or boutique pieces; we don’t accept fast‑fashion/high‑street, except we’re more flexible for sizes UK 16+ (US 12+/EU 44+).
Build trust:
Use a clear profile picture (you or your brand logo).
Write a friendly “About Me” with your style and lending goals – this really boosts bookings and trust.
Optional extras:
You can later sell items if you become a Verified Lender; buyers pay via in‑app purchase and sales are final.
Use the “Give £10, Get £10” referral link from your profile to invite friends: they get £10 off their first rental or resale (min spend £20), and once they complete it, you get £10 too.

That’s your starter roadmap: sign up, get verified, complete your profile, then either start renting pieces you love or list an item using great photos and a clear description.
